services.desc: Our Whale Sightings Guarantee. So far this year, we’ve had a sightings success rate of over 95%! While wildlife can be unpredictable, we want you to have the best chance of seeing whales. If we don’t encounter whales on your tour, you are welcome to join us again on a standby basis - your base fare is on us (taxes and fees still apply). Our whale guarantee never expires. BC Local Discount. If you’re a BC resident with a valid BC Services Card, enjoy 20% off our Ocean Cruiser tours! services.name: Ocean Cruiser Tour
services.desc: Join us aboard Marauder IV - our ultra comfortable Ocean Cruiser, perfect for all ages and available from spring through fall! This vessel offers unparalleled 360-degree views and is recognized as the most stable and best whale-watching platform in British Columbia. Enjoy spacious indoor and outdoor viewing decks with plenty of seating, a heated cabin, and convenient amenities like a washroom and complimentary coffee, tea, and hot chocolate. We also provide all-weather jackets and pants onboard to keep you cozy. With our friendly, experienced, and passionate crew, your adventure is guaranteed to be both enjoyable and unforgettable!
